limitations: Only single-target Bernoulli resetting and uniform neighboring steps on complete bipartite graphs; fixed-opposite-part and proportional-part asymptotic regimes only. Global finite-size optimizer uniqueness is not asserted; historical priority not independently certified.
scientific_integrity: The exact transition probabilities and stationary state were independently reconstructed. The asymptotic optimization requires proved global localization, not merely numerical finite-size optimization. The checker is supplementary finite evidence.
title: Entropy-optimal resetting on complete bipartite walks: a degree-imbalance crossover
